team.page.heading: Working together
team.page.start: Invite others to work on this project
team.page.start_line: You lead the project. Each of you works in your own copy of Idiograph, one person on each participant, and the others see that work as it changes.
team.page.join_start: Join a project you were invited to
team.page.join_start_line: Paste the link or the twelve words you were sent. This project then becomes your copy of theirs.
team.page.again_line: With the same people as when you stopped.
team.page.finish_unnamed: Finish joining the project you were invited to
team.page.unlisted: This computer is not on this project's list.
team.page.route_line: Each of you keeps the project's files on your own computer. Only the updates go through the relay or the folder, sealed first.
team.page.folder_missing: This folder is not there. Check that its drive or sync app is connected, or choose it again.

team.page.folder_unopened.one: {n} file in it will not open yet. Keep the folder on this computer. In OneDrive, choose Always keep on this device.
team.page.folder_unopened.other: {n} files in it will not open yet. Keep the folder on this computer. In OneDrive, choose Always keep on this device.

team.page.remove_ask: Remove {name}? {name} will get nothing new. What {name} already has stays on their computer.
team.page.remove_computer_ask: Remove {computer}? It will get nothing new. What it already has stays on it.
team.page.make_lead_ask: Make {name} the lead? From then on {name} adds and removes people, and you cannot.
team.page.asked_add: {computer} goes on the list when {lead}'s Idiograph next opens the project.
team.page.asked_remove: {computer} comes off the list when {lead}'s Idiograph next opens the project.
team.page.removed: You are no longer on this project's list. Nothing new comes to this computer. What you have stays here.
team.page.invite_row_own: Invite for another computer of yours, waiting for an answer
team.page.cancel_invite_ask: Cancel this invite? Nobody can join with it, and the people already on the project stay.
team.page.answered_line_own: Your other computer has answered your invite
team.page.stop_ask_member: Stop working together? You stay on the list until {lead} removes you.
team.page.stop_ask_lead: Stop working together? Nothing more is sent or taken in here, and the others keep what they have.
team.page.stop_ask_alone: Stop working together in this project?
team.page.hand_over_ask: Hand over the GETs board to {name}?
team.page.came_in_gets: {name}'s changes to the GETs board came in at {time}
team.held.day: Changes are waiting to send. This project has sent its 100 MB through the relay today. The rest goes after midnight UTC.
team.held.day_messages: Changes are waiting to send. This project has sent as many changes through the relay today as it takes in a day. The rest go after midnight UTC.
team.held.project_full: Changes are waiting to send. The relay is holding as much of this project as it keeps until the others fetch it. Idiograph tries again in an hour.
team.held.project_full_who: Changes are waiting to send. The relay is holding as much of this project as it keeps until {who} fetch it. Idiograph tries again in an hour.
team.held.relay_full: Changes are waiting to send. The relay is full just now. Idiograph tries again in an hour.
team.held.files_day: Recordings and large files are waiting to send. This project has sent all the files the relay takes today. Other changes still go, and the files go after midnight UTC.
team.held.files_project_full: Recordings and large files are waiting to send. The relay is holding as much of this project as it keeps until the others fetch it. Other changes still go, and Idiograph tries the files again in an hour.
team.held.files_project_full_who: Recordings and large files are waiting to send. The relay is holding as much of this project as it keeps until {who} fetch it. Other changes still go, and Idiograph tries the files again in an hour.
team.held.files_relay_full: Recordings and large files are waiting to send. The relay is full of files just now. Other changes still go, and Idiograph tries the files again in an hour.
team.held.blocked: Changes are waiting to send. The relay is turning away calls from this internet address just now. Idiograph tries again in a minute.
team.held.closed: Changes are waiting to send. The relay is not taking calls just now. They wait on this computer and go when it opens again.
team.held.nobody: Recordings and large changes are waiting to send. Nobody else is on this project yet, so the relay keeps nothing large for it. They go once someone has joined.
team.held.files_relay_today: Recordings and large files are waiting to send. The relay has taken all the files it takes today. Other changes still go, and the files go after midnight UTC.
team.held.fetched_too_often: A file waiting on the relay could not be fetched by this computer, and the relay will not give it again. Changes from the others wait behind it. The lead can remove this computer and invite it again.
team.held.list_today: A computer you added is not let in yet. The relay takes only so many changes to the list of computers a day, and this project has used today's. This computer sends the list again after midnight UTC.
team.held.list_removed: The relay is not taking changes to the list of computers. This project has had as many computers removed as the relay allows, and that does not lift by itself. Send through a shared folder to carry on.
team.held.gone: This project is no longer on the relay. Idiograph asks again in an hour. Your copy of the project is as it was.
team.held.too_large: A file of {participant} is over {mb} MB, too large for the relay, so it has not been sent. Send through a shared folder to share it.
team.held.too_large_folder: A file of {participant} is over {mb} MB, too large for the shared folder, so it has not been sent.
team.held.study_too_large: The study's settings with their pictures are over {mb} MB, too large for the relay, so they have not been sent.
team.held.study_too_large_folder: The study's settings with their pictures are over {mb} MB, too large for the shared folder, so they have not been sent.
team.page.your_name_ask: Your name, as the others will see it
team.invite.heading: Invite someone
team.invite.route_relay: This project's updates go through the relay.
team.invite.route_folder: This project's updates go through the folder {folder}.
team.invite.route_relay_lead: This project's updates go through the relay. {name} chooses this.
team.invite.route_folder_lead: This project's updates go through the folder {folder}. {name} chooses this.
team.invite.answered: {name} has answered. On a call, read this number to each other.
team.invite.answered_own: Your other computer has answered. Check that it shows the same six digits.
team.join.heading: Join a project
team.join.by_folder: The invite came through a shared folder
team.join.read_code: Read this number to {name} on a call.
team.join.read_code_own: Check that your other computer shows the same six digits.
team.join.waiting: Waiting for {name} to say they match.
team.join.waiting_unnamed: Waiting for the lead to say they match.
team.join.waiting_own: Waiting for your other computer to say they match.
team.refused.needs_library: Working together needs a part this copy of Idiograph lacks. Start it from a fresh download, or delete the .venv folder beside it and start it again.
team.refused.tampered: That message was changed on the way, so it was refused.
team.refused.too_large: That is too large to send in one message.
team.refused.no_device: This computer has no keys for Working together yet.
team.refused.roster_not_lead: That list of people was not signed by the project's lead, so it was refused.
team.refused.roster_old: That list of people is older than the one here, so it was refused.
team.refused.not_on_roster: That message came from a computer not on the project's list, so it was refused.
team.refused.bad_signature: That message's signature does not match its computer, so it was refused.
team.refused.kind_not_allowed: That message is one only the lead may send, so it was refused.
team.refused.no_key: This computer has no key for that message.
team.refused.bad_words: Those are not the twelve words of an invite. Check each word, or paste the link.
team.refused.no_name: Say your name, as the others will see it.
team.refused.off: Working together is off in this project.
team.refused.lead_only: Only the project's lead can do that.
team.refused.route_lead: Only the project's lead chooses how the team sends. Nothing changed.
team.refused.bad_route: Send through takes relay or folder.
team.refused.no_participant: No participant named {who} in this project.
team.refused.no_member: Nobody named {who} works on this project.
team.refused.no_invite: No invite of that link or those words is open.
team.refused.invite_used: That invite has been used. Ask for a new one.
team.refused.invite_expired: That invite is more than seven days old. Ask for a new one.
team.refused.no_answer: Nobody has answered that invite yet.
team.refused.already_on: That computer is on the project's list already.
team.refused.already_team: This project is shared with others already.
team.refused.kept_team: This project keeps a team from before with others on it, so it cannot join another. Join from a new project.
team.refused.has_participants: This project has participants that are not in the project you were invited to, so it cannot join it. Nothing was sent. Join from a new project with no participants.
team.refused.replace_ask: Leave {mine} and join {theirs}? This project becomes a copy of {project}.
team.refused.replace_same: Make this project a copy of {project}? It leaves its own team.
team.refused.replace_late: This project was not changed. Ask the lead for a new invite to join their team.
team.refused.replace_team:
{ask}
Nothing was sent. To go ahead, join again with replace (the command line's --replace).
team.refused.no_computer: That computer is not on the project's list.
team.refused.this_computer: That is the computer you are on. Remove it from another computer of yours.
team.refused.last_computer: That is {name}'s only computer. Remove {name} instead.
team.refused.no_connection: The others could not be reached just now. Nothing changed.
team.refused.folder_missing: The shared folder is not there: {folder}. Check that its drive or sync app is connected, or choose it again.
team.refused.invite_not_here: That invite is not in the shared folder on this computer yet. It may still be syncing. Try again in a minute.
team.refused.blob_not_here: That file has not reached the shared folder on this computer yet.
team.refused.no_route: This copy of Idiograph cannot send through that yet.
team.refused.no_op: That is not one of Working together's actions.
team.refused.not_yours_gets: The GETs board is {name}'s. Comment or suggest instead.
team.refused.relay_unreached: The relay could not be reached just now. Nothing changed.
team.refused.relay_refused: The relay refused that. Nothing changed.
team.refused.relay_no_projects: The relay cannot start any more new projects today. Try again tomorrow, or send through a shared folder. Nothing changed.
team.refused.relay_full: The relay is full just now, so it cannot start a project. Send through a shared folder instead. Nothing changed.
team.refused.relay_no_invites: This project has made all the invites the relay takes in a day. Try again tomorrow. Nothing changed.
team.refused.relay_slow_down: The relay has had too many calls from this internet address in the last minute. Wait a minute and try again. Nothing changed.
team.refused.made_no_invites: The project is now on the relay, but it has made all the invites the relay takes in a day. Try Invite again tomorrow.
team.refused.made_slow_down: The project is now on the relay, but the relay has had too many calls from this internet address in the last minute. Wait a minute and try Invite again.
team.refused.made_unreached: The project is now on the relay, but the relay could not be reached to make the invite. Try Invite again.
team.refused.made_refused: The project is now on the relay, but the relay refused the invite. Try Invite again.
team.refused.no_relay: This project is not on the relay yet. The lead's Idiograph puts it there when the lead invites someone.
team.history.on_relay: {name} turned on Working together. The project sends through the relay.
team.history.on_folder: {name} turned on Working together. The project sends through a shared folder.
team.history.route_relay: Send through changed to the relay.
team.history.route_folder: Send through changed to a shared folder.
team.history.gets_owner: The GETs board is {name}'s to work on.
team.history.invite: An invite was made. It is open for seven days.
team.history.invite_own: An invite was made to add a computer. It is open for seven days.
team.history.thrown: The answer from {name} was thrown away because the check codes differed.
team.history.stopped: {name} stopped working together. {name} stays on the list until you remove them.
team.history.removed: {name} removed. The project's key changed, so {name} gets nothing new.
team.history.computer_asked: Another computer of {name}'s was let in. It goes on the list when {lead}'s Idiograph takes it in.
team.history.computer_removed: {name}'s computer {computer} was removed. The project's key changed, so it gets nothing new.
team.history.computer_remove_asked: Asked {lead}'s Idiograph to remove {computer}. It gets nothing new once it is off the list.
team.history.list_taken: The list of people brought up to date.
team.history.relay_made: The project made on the relay.
team.cli.off: Working together is off in this project.
team.cli.on: Working together is on. The project sends through {route}.
team.cli.recordings_off: The recordings stay on this computer.
team.cli.invite_made: Invite made, open until {expires}. Send the link by email, or read the words out. It works once.
team.cli.answered: {name} has answered. Check code: {code}. Read it to each other on a call, then run team admit with --match or --differ.
team.cli.answered_own: Your other computer has answered. Check code: {code}. Check that it shows the same six digits, then run team admit with --match or --differ.
team.cli.join_code: Check code: {code}. Read it to {name} on a call. Once they say it matches, run team joined with --invite {invite}.
team.cli.join_code_own: Check code: {code}. Check that your other computer shows the same six digits. Once it matches, run team joined with --invite {invite}.
team.cli.joined: Joined. The project's key is on this computer.
team.cli.not_joined: Not joined yet: the lead has not said the check codes match.
team.cli.agent_relay: Only the researcher starts a project on the relay. Ask them to turn Working together on in Project settings, or use route folder.
team.cli.no_remove: Say who to remove by name, or one computer with --computer and its id from team show.
team.cli.unlisted: This computer is not on this project's list. team join with --copy makes this project a copy of the team whose invite you give.
team.cli.removed: You are no longer on this project's list. Nothing new comes to this computer.
team.home.title: Join a shared project
team.home.not_empty: That folder has files in it. Choose an empty folder or a new one.
team.home.not_made: That folder could not be made. Choose another folder or a shorter name.
team.home.would_make: Would make the project in {folder} and join it.
team.home.own: This invite adds this computer to your own team.
team.cli.offer_own: An invite for another computer of yours, to {project}.
team.cli.offer_folder: If you join, the project is kept in {folder}.
